annual.label: Annual Report 2026
annual.summary: Net interest margin improved to 8.0%, PBT-ROTA was maintained at 3.3%, and return on equity remained healthy at 19.7%. Chola operates from 1,761 branches across India with assets under management above INR 2.42+ lakh crore. Total disbursements increased to ₹1,11,642 crore from ₹1,00,869 crore in the previous year.
highlights: Net interest margin improved to 8.0%, PBT-ROTA was maintained at 3.3%, and return on equity remained healthy at 19.7%.
Chola operates from 1,761 branches across India with assets under management above INR 2.42+ lakh crore.
Total disbursements increased to ₹1,11,642 crore from ₹1,00,869 crore in the previous year.
Business AUM grew 21% to ₹2,24,334 crore, while total assets under management stood at ₹2,42,630 crore.
